note.line: No model changed price this week; the index moved on new entries: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 came in at $16 per million blended tokens, 20% under the 5.1 pair, and Google's Gemini 4 Carbon came in at $4 on an introductory price that doubles on 1 December.
note.body:
Google also released Gemini 4 Hydrogen at $3 blended, and Gemini Decision 1, which answers yes/no, category and rubric questions for $0.10 per million input tokens and bills no output.

Rent for GPUs rose. Nebius says its average price per GPU-hour rose more than 20% from Q2 to Q3, and IREN signed new H100 contracts at double its earlier price. Anthropic's amended S-1 shows seven of its suppliers, among them Google and NVIDIA at about $10B each, buying $26.0B of its stock at the IPO price.
note.subject: Anthropic cuts 20%, GPU rent rises
